experiment_data.hypothesis: If adaptive weighting's FineWeb PPL improvement is genuine quality gain (not tautological distribution matching), then adaptive should also show lower PPL on non-FineWeb eval sets (C4/OpenWebText, Wikipedia). If the improvement is purely distribution matching, adaptive will only win on FineWeb-derived evals.

spec.data_count: 5000 docs x 3 eval sets x 2 models = 6 runs
spec.eval_data: FineWeb holdout (4.1M tokens), OpenWebText (6.8M tokens), Wikipedia (27M tokens)
